title: This Kangaroo Lives in Trees and Leaps 18 Meters Down
subject: tree kangaroo

scenes.text: Kangaroos hop. This one climbs trees, and it jumps off them.
It's a tree kangaroo, from the rainforests of New Guinea. It lives high in the canopy.
It can bound nine meters across to a neighboring tree.
And when danger comes, it leaps straight down. From up to 18 meters, about a six-story building.
Zoos report it lands without injury. Strong back legs and thick fur help it absorb the drop.
A kangaroo that skips the stairs. Eighteen meters, no ladder.

description:
Kangaroos hop. This one lives in trees and leaps down from 18 meters.
Tree kangaroos from New Guinea can also bound nine meters between trees.
Would you jump from six floors up? Tell us below.
first_comment: Would you rather hop like a kangaroo or climb like this one? Tell us which animal to cover next.
